name: Venture Rewards from Capital One

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. You won't pay a transaction fee when making purchases outside of the United States.

base_rate.description: Get unlimited 2X miles per dollar on every purchase, every day.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem miles for travel, cash back, gift cards, experiences and more. Transfer miles to 15+ travel loyalty programs. Miles don't expire for the life of the account.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 75,000 bonus miles once you spend $4,000 on purchases within the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: You won't pay a transaction fee when making purchases outside of the United States.

benefits.title: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck credit
benefits.description: Receive up to a $120 statement credit when you use your Venture card to apply for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck®.

benefits.title: Hertz Five Star status
benefits.description: Eligible Venture cardholders receive complimentary Hertz® Five Star status. Skip the rental counter and choose from a wider selection of cars.

benefits.title: Lifestyle Collection $50 experience credit
benefits.description: Receive a $50 experience credit on every Lifestyle Collection stay. Plus, enjoy room upgrades, early check-in, and late checkout when available.

benefits.title: Capital One Travel
benefits.description: Earn 5X miles on hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel. Save an average of 15% on flights using price prediction and free price drop protection. Price match guarantee on flights, hotels and rental cars.

benefits.title: Capital One Entertainment
benefits.description: Access cardholder-only VIP packages and thousands of tickets to events in sports, music, dining, theater and more, plus redeem your rewards for tickets and packages.

benefits.title: Travel accident insurance
benefits.description: Get automatic insurance for a covered loss at no extra charge when you use your credit card to purchase your fare.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Rent an eligible vehicle with your credit card and you can be covered for damage due to collision or theft.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.description: You'll get additional warranty protection at no charge on eligible items that are purchased with your credit card.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: If your card is lost or stolen, you can get an emergency replacement and a cash advance.

other: $50 experience credit on Lifestyle Collection stays

notes: Verified against official Capital One product page on 2026-07-24. Corrected name from 'Venture Rewards Travel Card — Apply Today' to 'Venture Rewards from Capital One' per page heading.
